pages.text: The $(thing)Pure Daisy$() is a sacred flower of transformation. When placed among ordinary stone, it slowly purifies the rock into $(thing)Living Rock$() — the foundation material of all Verdant Path crafting.

Place the Pure Daisy on any solid surface. Within a few seconds, each adjacent stone block will begin to shimmer and convert, one at a time. The daisy can convert up to 8 blocks before needing a moment to rest.
